about: The sentences about registration, licences, accreditation, regulation, membership or a public authority that the BOOM city desks (cities/*.json) and the hub /desks are allowed to print. The build (build-cities.mjs, reviewSentences + claimGuard) takes every sentence of every page that uses that vocabulary - visible text (entities decoded, NFKC, no zero-width characters), each meta, each JSON-LD string, every attribute that carries words, CSS content strings, inline-script strings - and refuses the page unless the sentence is listed here word for word (default deny). The only registration BOOM states is the company's: Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., registered in Rome (REA RM-1710623, Viale Liegi 42); no desk holds a local licence, registration or membership (the Valencian RAICV, the Catalan AICAT and the UK redress scheme are open legal questions). Kinds: company-rome (the company in Rome), trade-mark (the EUTM), lease (a lease registered under local law), tenant (the tenant's own registrations or enrolments), deposit (where the landlord lodges the deposit), listing (an advertised home), law (what the law requires, or an honest negation), partner (a draft desk opening with a licensed partner; refused on a desk that sells), heading (a section name), context (a sentence with no such word that stands next to the company's Rome line and names a desk place: reviewed so the Rome registration is never continued elsewhere). To add a sentence: read it on the page; if it does not say that BOOM or the company holds a registration, licence or membership outside Rome, add {text, kind, note} here, in sorted order, with the note saying why; if it does, it cannot ship. The build lints this file (no named register, the company never the subject of a licence outside company-rome/law/partner, company-rome lands on Rome and names no other place after it) and the tests refuse an entry no page prints.
